description: Voice redirect to a named coordinator with a direct number.

event.body:
AI: Hello, this is an AI assistant calling on behalf of a patient about a new-patient visit.
Callee: You want our sarcoma program coordinator, Alicia Brandt. Her direct line is 202-555-0189.
AI: Thank you. Could you repeat the number?
Callee: 202-555-0189.
AI: Thank you, goodbye.

expected.rationale: The callee directed the call to a named coordinator and gave her direct number.
expected.quote: You want our sarcoma program coordinator, Alicia Brandt.
